snippet.title: Micromega - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Developer Overview Trailer for Micromega, a 2D puzzle physics-based adventure game developed by Coven. Players will guide a sphere through stylized worlds by way of strange creatures, environmental elements, and time manipulation. Unlock paths and overcome challenges in Micromega, coming soon to PC (Steam).
